description: Supplement of the interface-sizes vocabulary: the FPV size keys the commons cartridges' size_key maps need and the base file did not define (fpv-camera-cage's cam_size and frame ears, fpv-antenna-mount's connector and foot). Same rules as the base: two interfaces mate only when their resolved size keys are EQUAL, and every dimension cites a public standard or manufacturer source. Merged into interface-sizes when the vocabulary is loaded.

review.note: Keys, labels and definitions drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-AUTH-C lane, 2026-10-04). No language facet has had a native review; Spanish is the bar a reviewer should read first. Facts were read from the cited sources on the access date.

label.es: Cámara FPV mini, clase de 21 mm
label.pt: Câmera FPV mini, classe de 21 mm

definition.en: The body of a 'mini' FPV camera, the class between micro (19 mm) and full size (28 mm), held between the two side plates of a camera cage or a frame's camera bay.
definition.es: El cuerpo de una cámara FPV 'mini', la clase entre la micro (19 mm) y la de tamaño completo (28 mm), sujeto entre las dos placas laterales de una jaula de cámara o del hueco de cámara de un marco.
definition.fr: Le boîtier d'une caméra FPV « mini », la classe entre la micro (19 mm) et la taille standard (28 mm), tenu entre les deux flasques d'une cage de caméra ou de la baie caméra d'un châssis.
definition.pt: O corpo de uma câmera FPV 'mini', a classe entre a micro (19 mm) e a de tamanho completo (28 mm), preso entre as duas placas laterais de uma gaiola de câmera ou do compartimento de câmera de um quadro.

bracket_width.note: the full-size adapter bracket both listings ship

sources.title: Foxeer Toothless 2 Mini (1/2" sensor, M12 1.7 mm lens) — retailer specification
sources.supports: dimensions 21.8 × 21.8 mm; includes a 28 mm bracket for full-size mounting

sources.title: Foxeer Arrow Mini Pro FPV camera
sources.supports: dimension 22 × 22 mm; 28 × 22 mm with the extension bracket

entries.notes: The commons calls this class '21 mm' (fpv-camera-cage's cam_size table); the cited class members measure 21.8–22 mm. A cradle sized from a nominal 21 mm must add clearance for the real body. A mini camera does not mate a micro key: the two keys are different on purpose.

definition.en: A hole that routes an antenna's ultra-fine coax lead, terminated in a Hirose U.FL plug, out of a printed mount. There is no panel connector at the hole: the U.FL plug mates on the transmitter's board, not on the mount.
definition.es: Un barreno que saca de un soporte impreso el cable coaxial ultrafino de una antena, terminado en un conector Hirose U.FL. En el barreno no hay conector de panel: el U.FL se acopla en la placa del transmisor, no en el soporte.
definition.fr: Un trou qui fait sortir d'un support imprimé le câble coaxial ultrafin d'une antenne, terminé par une fiche Hirose U.FL. Il n'y a pas d'embase au trou : la fiche U.FL se connecte sur la carte de l'émetteur, pas sur le support.
definition.pt: Um furo que leva para fora de um suporte impresso o cabo coaxial ultrafino de uma antena, terminado num conector Hirose U.FL. Não há conector de painel no furo: o U.FL encaixa na placa do transmissor, não no suporte.

sources.title: U.FL Series — Ultra Small Surface Mount Coaxial Connectors, 1.9 mm or 2.3 mm, 2.4 mm mated height (catalogue, Jun. 2020)
sources.supports: plug cable assemblies for Ø0.81, Ø0.95, Ø1.13, Ø1.32 and Ø1.37 mm coax; mated height 2.5 mm max (2.4 nominal), 2.4 max or 2.0 max by plug; DC to 6 GHz, 50 Ω; plugs ordered only as terminated cable assemblies

entries.notes: A cable route, not a panel connector: no part mates it the way an SMA jack mates sma-bulkhead, so a mount framed with this key resolves a size but has no catalogue partner. The exit diameter (fpv-antenna-mount uses Ø2.6) is the mount's choice, not this key's.

label.es: Tornillo lateral de cámara en placa del marco
label.fr: Vis latérale caméra sur flasque du châssis
label.pt: Parafuso lateral da câmara na placa do quadro

definition.en: The camera side screw through a carbon side plate of an FPV frame's camera bay: one screw per plate on the camera's tilt axis. A part fixed by it bears on the plate's outer face (an ear of a camera cage) or its inner face (the camera itself).
definition.es: El tornillo lateral de cámara a través de una placa lateral de carbono del hueco de cámara de un marco FPV: un tornillo por placa sobre el eje de inclinación de la cámara. La pieza que fija apoya en la cara exterior de la placa (una oreja de jaula de cámara) o en la interior (la propia cámara).
definition.fr: La vis latérale de caméra à travers un flasque carbone de la baie caméra d'un châssis FPV : une vis par flasque, sur l'axe d'inclinaison de la caméra. La pièce qu'elle fixe appuie sur la face extérieure du flasque (une oreille de cage caméra) ou sur sa face intérieure (la caméra elle-même).
definition.pt: O parafuso lateral da câmara através de uma placa lateral de carbono do compartimento de câmara de um quadro FPV: um parafuso por placa, no eixo de inclinação da câmara. A peça que fixa apoia na face exterior da placa (uma orelha de gaiola de câmara) ou na interior (a própria câmara).

screw_count_per_plate.note: the camera's two side screws, one through each plate

sources.title: GEPRC GEP-Mark4 frame
sources.supports: 2.5 mm top, bottom and side plates

entries.notes: The screw thread is not published by the cited listings, so it is not a fact of this key; a cage's ear hole is the cage's choice. The outer faces of the two plates stand bay + 2 × plate thickness apart (24 mm at 19 + 2 × 2.5); whether two ears match that spacing is decided by mate closure, not by this key.

label.es: Patrón de montaje de VTX, 20 × 20 mm
label.pt: Padrão de montagem de VTX, 20 × 20 mm

definition.en: The four-hole 20 × 20 mm pattern an FPV frame provides for a video transmitter. A part seated on it may use all four holes or one pair of them (an antenna mount's two-bolt foot on one 20 mm row).
definition.es: El patrón de cuatro barrenos de 20 × 20 mm que un marco FPV ofrece para el transmisor de video. Una pieza asentada en él puede usar los cuatro barrenos o un par (el pie de dos tornillos de un soporte de antena sobre una fila de 20 mm).
definition.fr: Le motif de quatre trous de 20 × 20 mm qu'un châssis FPV prévoit pour l'émetteur vidéo. Une pièce posée dessus peut utiliser les quatre trous ou une paire (le pied à deux vis d'un support d'antenne sur une rangée de 20 mm).
definition.pt: O padrão de quatro furos de 20 × 20 mm que um quadro FPV oferece para o transmissor de vídeo. Uma peça assente nele pode usar os quatro furos ou um par (o pé de dois parafusos de um suporte de antena numa fila de 20 mm).

entries.notes: The hole geometry equals stack-20x20-m*, but this is a different seat (a transmitter or an antenna foot, not a flight-controller stack), so the keys stay distinct. The cited listing gives the spacing, not the thread, so the thread is not a fact of this key; where the pattern sits on a frame is the frame's own (rear_mount_x_mm on fpv-frame-5in-x-225).
